tex_content.label: sec:radial-symmetry
tex_content.html: Let $U=B^0(0,1)\subset \R ^n$, let $f:\R \to \R $ be Lipschitz, and suppose \[ \begin{cases} -\Delta u=f(u) & \text{in }U,\\ u=0 & \text{on }\partial U, \end{cases} \tag {2} \qquad u>0\quad \text{in }U. \tag {3} \]
